articles.headline: Wrexham wait for home win goes on after draw with struggling Burnley
articles.description: Wrexham's wait for a home win goes on after they were held to a 1-1 draw by winless Burnley, who sit one place off the bottom of the Sky Bet Championship.

articles.headline: Wolves boss Peixoto on potential VAR use in the Championship: 'Important to be more fair'
articles.description: Wolves head coach Cesar Peixoto lamented the absence of VAR in the Championship after Jay Stansfield's goal for Birmingham in Sunday's 2-2 draw at St Andrew's.

articles.headline: Jamie Vardy joins Burnley on a season-long contract
articles.description: Former Leicester forward Jamie Vardy has joined Burnley for the remainder of the season, the club have announced.

articles.headline: Portsmouth urge supporters not to speculate on social media as fan incident with Cardiff player is investigated
articles.description: Portsmouth have urged supporters not to speculate on social media while an investigation takes place into an altercation between a Pompey fan and Cardiff defender Krystian Bielik on Saturday.

articles.headline: Mo Touré goals again for Norwich City
articles.description: Mo Touré slides one past the keeper in Norwich City's 3-1 win over Sheffield United in the Championship.

images.name: Mo Touré goals again for Norwich City
images.caption: Mo Touré slides one past the keeper in Norwich City's 3-1 win over Sheffield United in the Championship.

articles.headline: Wrexham boss Parkinson fumes at potential 'leg-breaking' tackle
articles.description: Wrexham boss Phil Parkinson said Ben Cabango should have been sent off for what could have been a "leg breaking" challenge on Callum O'Hare in his side's stalemate with Swansea.
